author: user_1
text: I save a lot of sneakers to wishlist on Myntra but usually wait because the size fit feels inconsistent and there are not enough customer photos.

author: user_2
text: Wishlist is basically my bookmark folder for kurtas I may buy later. I end up checking YouTube try on videos before deciding.

author: user_3
text: For footwear under ₹2000 I compare Myntra with AJIO and then forget which pair I had shortlisted because the wishlist gets too crowded.

author: user_4
text: I save jackets on Myntra but do not buy until I know whether they fit my style and what other people’s photos look like.

author: user_5
text: I keep saving jeans and tops on Myntra, but without enough styled looks I do not know which wishlist item deserves to be bought first.

author: user_6
text: My wishlist has too many handbags now, so when I return later I forget why I saved them and end up buying nothing.

author: user_7
text: I save ethnic wear on Myntra but wait until I confirm the event plan and see better customer photos before purchasing.

author: user_8
text: Wishlisting sneakers is easy, but the app still leaves me unsure about fit and that is why those saved items just stay there.

author: user_9
text: I compare every saved shoe on Myntra with other apps and the longer I compare the less likely I am to purchase.

author: user_10
text: For wishlist dresses I need more social proof and real photos because catalog shots alone are not enough to make me buy.
